name: Their overworld sprites' four views, against BN4's own scripts
result: Each proved Navi's list-6 sprite decoded and its animations' first frames compared pixel for pixel: 0-7 by BN6's facings, each pair one diagonal's view (0-1 up-right, 2-3 down-right, 4-5 down-left, 6-7 up-left, the left flipped by its own objects); WindMan's 0-3 the four diagonals alone; TopMan's and SparkMan's backs empty; BN4's MegaMan all eight. BN4's NPC commands decoded (0x16 the animation at +0x14, 0x17 list 6's sprite, 0x26 the mirror) and every script setting a proved Navi's sprite walked: the odd animations alone (Roll 30 times in 1, 3, 5, 7), WindMan's 2 and 0, no 0x26. In BN6's engine, before: facing left GutsMan, Roll, FireMan, ThunderMan and AquaMan showed their backs, WindMan, TopMan and SparkMan nothing; after (guardian_body by xguardian_bn4_stand), all twelve in their front views turned to MegaMan at seed 1 (right) and seed 3 (left).
meaning: BN4's Navis stand in the diagonal nearest a facing, a side turned to the camera; the pale animation each script plays after the beam's sound is BN4's own log-out, left for a later change.
